newsitem.title: USA: BayBank wins bulk of $25 mln Methuen, Mass. BANs.
newsitem.headline: BayBank wins bulk of $25 mln Methuen, Mass. BANs.

text.p: BayBank said it won the bulk of Methuen, Mass.'s $25 million bond anticipation note offering.
BayBank won $10 million of the issue with a coupon of 4.25 percent and a net interest cost (NIC) of 3.84 percent.
BayBank also won $5 million with a 4.25 percent coupon and an NIC of 3.78 percent and another $5 million with a 4.25 percent coupon and an NIC of 3.73 percent.
State Street Bank won $5 million with 4 percent coupon and an NIC of 3.744 percent.
